steel_spread.note: US EAF metal spread = HRC minus prime busheling scrap - the margin that drives Nucor and Steel Dynamics. HRC in $/short ton (SMU, published weekly); scrap in $/gross ton (RMDAS, settles monthly). Spread shown in $/short ton with scrap converted at 1 gross ton = 1.12 short tons. Benchmark data on weekly/monthly cadence, not a live tick. Update HRC weekly and scrap monthly from the cited sources.

NUE.name: Nucor Corporation
NUE.briefing:
### Nucor (NUE) — trader read

- **Largest US steelmaker**, ~25–30% of domestic capacity, all electric-arc-furnace (scrap-fed) — low fixed cost, flexes with demand.
- **HRC spot ~$1,145/st**, raised on Section 232 tariff support; EAF margins geared to scrap spread.
- **Diversified mix**: sheet, bar, structural, plate — less cyclical than a pure flat-rolled name.
- **Watch**: scrap prices, non-residential construction, tariff headlines.

STLD.name: Steel Dynamics, Inc.
STLD.briefing:
### Steel Dynamics (STLD) — trader read

- **#3 US carbon steel producer**, ~13 Mt capacity, EAF like Nucor.
- **Sinton mill** ramping adds flat-roll supply in the South.
- **Also a large metals recycler** (OmniSource) — vertically integrated into scrap.
- **Watch**: Sinton utilization, scrap spread, fabrication backlog.

CLF.name: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc.
CLF.briefing:
### Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF) — trader read

- **Largest flat-rolled producer for autos**, integrated blast-furnace shop — higher fixed cost, more operating leverage than EAF peers.
- **Trades cheaper (~6.5x)** on debt load and limited diversification.
- **Iron ore self-sufficient** — owns its raw material chain.
- **Watch**: auto build rates, iron ore, debt maturities, M&A chatter (US Steel history).

AA.name: Alcoa Corporation
AA.briefing:
### Alcoa (AA) — trader read

- **Vertically integrated aluminum**: bauxite mining, alumina refining, primary metal — the only pure-play US name of scale.
- **Leveraged to LME aluminum and alumina (API) prices**; energy cost is the swing factor at smelters.
- **Note**: capacity here is in different units per stage (metal vs. refining vs. mining) — not comparable to steel tons.
- **Watch**: LME aluminum, alumina spot, power contracts, tariffs on imported metal.

RYZ.name: Ryerson Holding Corporation (incl. Olympic Steel)
RYZ.briefing:
### Ryerson + Olympic Steel (RYZ) — trader read

- **Metals service center / distributor**, not a producer — buys, processes, and resells stainless, aluminum, carbon and alloy.
- **Merged with Olympic Steel (Feb 2026)**; Q1'26 revenue up >30% YoY on the combined volumes.
- **Margins are spread + volume**, not commodity price direction — different beast from the mills above.
- **Watch**: service-center spreads, integration/synergies, industrial demand.
- *Capacity is not a meaningful metric for a distributor — shown as volume/spread instead.*
